EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATE

This is to certify that {name} ({reg_no}), S/o {s_o}, has successfully completed his internship with Shine Craft Technologies as a {role} from {from_date} to {to_date}

He has shown enthusiasm and dedication in working on the following areas in our Software Development Division:

Project Implementation:Actively contributed to the development of a NFC-based Smart Attendance System. Built and integrated both backend services using Express.js with TypeScript and Flutter-based frontend components to enable login, employee registration, and attendance marking features.

Backend Development & API Integration:

·       Gained hands-on experience in backend development using Express with TypeScript and MongoDB.

·       Implemented RESTful APIs with JWT authentication and added cron-jobs for automated features.

·       Used Postman extensively for API documentation and integration testing.

System Utility Development: Developed a cross-platform Python script for extracting complete system information for assests monitoring and usage diagnostics logging. Packaged the utility using PyInstaller and created professional installers for Linux, Windows and MacOS ensuring usability across all major operating systems.

During his internship, {name} demonstrated a keen interest in learning, took initiative in solving technical issues, and showed excellent teamwork.

We wish him success in all his future endeavors.
